name: nativeee
description: Windows dependency manifest (the windows-* presets read it through the vcpkg toolchain): the two runtime libraries the binary links plus the Khronos GL registry headers (opengl-registry: GL/glcorearb.h for the Windows GL loader, engine/platform/windows/gl_loader.h), nothing else. builtin-baseline = the vcpkg commit the port versions are resolved against (github.com/microsoft/vcpkg master HEAD on 2026-10-17; VCPKG_ROOT must be a checkout that contains it); KEEP IDENTICAL to the TwinsanityEvolved port's vcpkg.json (its D55 item 8: one installed tree). macOS and Linux take the same two from Homebrew / the distribution.
